title: finance budget 1:1 prep - Lucas - 2026 Q1
body:
Goal for the 1:1
- Quick sync on current run-rate and top variance items vs plan
- Confirm procurement approvals needed this quarter (GPU nodes + MLOps tooling)
- Agree on any reforecasting / top-line assumptions to share with execs

Key numbers (current, rough)
- Run-rate spend (annualized): ~ $14.6M (company ops + infra + hiring included)
- Monthly burn (Feb actual): $1.18M; target range for Q2 planning: $0.9M - $1.1M
- Cloud/infra spend (run-rate): ~ $5.1M/yr (GCP + dedicated infra costs)
- Dedicated capacity committed spend (annualized): $1.6M (reserved GPU pools)

Top variance drivers (why spend is higher this qtr)
1) Spike in dedicated capacity usage for large customer pilots (Dec-Jan) -> one-time surcharges on burst capacity (~$140k)
2) Early procurement of on-prem GPUs for Private pilot (placed PO in Jan) -> capex shift, timing mismatch vs forecast (~$420k)
3) Higher than planned consulting spend for rollout of private control plane (~$85k)

Items I want to cover
- Procurement approvals required:
  * Final sign-off for additional 8x A100 nodes (on-prem) - procurement SOW appended in Confluence. Need exec PO approval and legal checklist completed. Aim: approve by 2026-03-10 to hit delivery ETA.
  * Annual SaaS license renewal for monitoring/observability tool (15% price increase requested). Decision: sign vs RFP. Owner: Priya to lead RFP if we decline. Deadline: 2026-03-15.
- Reforecast ask: do we want to bake in a 10% uplift to infra run-rate for Q2-Q4 to be conservative? Impact ~ +$510k/yr.
- Hiring: SRE hire (open req) budgeted but we are behind on fill. Approve carry-forward of headcount dollars into Q2 if hire slips.

Risks to surface to execs
- If Private pilot expands faster than planned, Dedicated capacity commits may need to increase leading to higher committed spend sooner. Mitigation: set a threshold trigger for auto-bursting vs reserved scale decision.
- Procurement timing for GPUs affects both capex and delivery schedule; delayed legal/KYC could push invoice into next quarter and distort run-rate. Ask: can procurement expedite legal review?

Draft asks for the meeting (explicit asks)
- Approval to raise conservative infra run-rate by 10% for planning (if yes, update financial model and send to FP&A) — decision needed this 1:1
- Sign-off to move forward with PO for 8x A100 nodes (final approval from exec finance) — target 2026-03-10
- Decide whether to accept 15% renewal on observability or proceed with RFP (Priya owned) — decision 2026-03-15

Proposed talking order (30 min)
1) 5 min: Quick status + run-rate headline numbers
2) 10 min: Procurement approvals (A100 PO + SaaS renewal)
3) 8 min: Reforecasting ask + hiring carry-forward
4) 5 min: Actions, owners, next check-ins

Follow-up action items (to capture during/after meeting)
- Lucas: If exec approves run-rate uplift, update model and push new numbers to CONFLUENCE-FT/budget-q1-2026 (due 2026-03-05)
- Priya: Prepare RFP docs for observability tool and timeline (due 2026-03-12)
- Ethan: Expedite procurement/legal review for GPU PO and surface blockers by 2026-03-04
- Finance ops: Prepare journal/prepaid accounting treatment note for capex timing (due 2026-03-08)

Open questions / unknowns to resolve
- Exact billing terms from the Dedicated capacity provider for burst usage — need detailed invoice breakdown (waiting from Sales Ops)
- Is there an alternative vendor for the on-prem GPUs with better lead time? (Ethan to check)

Notes / scratchpad (things to remember)
- If we push run-rate up now, communicate to product teams that cost ceilings are being adjusted so feature prioritization can be revisited.
- Consider adding a small contingency line (3%) for pilot-related surges in next quarter's plan.

Attachments / refs (placeholders)
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-FT/budget-q1-2026 (detailed model)
- Jira: JIRA-FIN-3412 (procurement request for GPUs)
- PR: github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pulls/218 (procurement automation changes)

End of prep notes.
summary: 1:1 prep covering run-rate, procurement approvals (8x A100 PO), observability renewal decision, and reforecasting ask. Draft actions and owners included.
